newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Two stocks boost Moroccan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Two stocks boost Moroccan bourse.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Wednesday 0.22 percent higher boosted by gains in conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement and cement firm Lafarge Ciment, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 535.15 points from 533.98 points on Tuesday.
Lafarge Ciment jumped 28 dirhams to close at 982 dirhams with only 100 shares traded on the official market.
ONA group, the biggest private holding company, fell five dirhams at 675 dirhams. Also down was blue chip stock Wafabank at 676 dirhams from 685 dirhams the day before.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the second biggest conglomerate, rose 18 dirhams to close at 648 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a blue chip stock, took six dirhams to trade at 494 dirhams.
Samir oil refinery, the country's main refinery, fell three dirhams to close at 250 dirhams.
"Small shareholders rushed to sell their stocks after it increased in value during a week," a broker at ABN Amro Finance said.
Credit firm Credor which was floated late December was up four dirhams to 619 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 47.2 million from 59.9 million dirhams on Tuesday.
